card.name: Scattered odd bits in codes and numbers
card.fires_on: No single word type. It fires on scattered pieces such as the middle of a DOI, a vanity phone number, an ordinal ending like th or st, or a footnote symbol.

modes.label: Vanity phone numbers
modes.description: Letters spelling a word inside a toll-free phone number.

modes.label: Ordinal endings
modes.description: The th or st ending after a numeral in a date or century.

modes.label: Reference and symbol pieces
modes.description: Pieces of identifiers or footnote marks after a brand name.

card.plain: It responds to unrelated odd bits of text like phone-number letters, date endings and footnote marks, with no single theme.
